text:
Maria G.: Heads up — Acme security sent a formal evidence request for our POC. They want request/response audit exports delivered to their S3 in us-east-1, 13 month retention, encrypted with customer KMS. They asked if this can be live during the POC and what the costs/timeline look like.

Jamal R.: Short answer: possible. Hosted API default logs are 30d only. For 13mo we do an export pipeline to customer S3 (our `audit-export` feature). Requires S3 bucket + IAM role or cross-account role + KMS ARN + signed DPA/addendum.

Priya S.: Details from security side:
- For Hosted: we can push audit bundles to customer S3 via an assumed role (recommended) or provide downloads of bundles. Customer-managed KMS is supported but we need the key policy to allow our service principal to Encrypt/Decrypt.
- For Dedicated: logs can be kept in their VPC and retention is under their control — easier for compliance.
- For Private/on-prem: they control everything, simplest for long retention.

Priya S.: Example minimal S3 bucket policy we ask customers to add (they can tweak):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-audit-export"},
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::your-acme-audit-bucket/*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

Priya S.: Also need a KMS key policy snippet permitting our service principal to use the key. We automatically redact obvious PII by default in hosted exports; if they request raw payloads (no redaction) that triggers a privacy review.

Alex P.: Cost questions: rough ballpark for quoting the customer — include one-time setup, monthly storage, and egress.

Jamal R.: Rough estimate for sizing conversation:
- One-time enablement + compliance onboarding: ~$3k (covers legal/engineering config)
- Storage: S3 pricing (request they estimate GB/month). We'll add $0.02/GB/month to cover our export processing (very rough).
- Engineering enablement SLA for POC: 2-5 business days after DPA + bucket details.

Maria G.: They also asked whether switching to a short Dedicated pool for the POC avoids export complexity.

Priya S.: Yes — Dedicated helps. If they take a Dedicated pool in their account/VPC we can write logs directly to their storage in-tenant and retention is controlled by them. That usually reduces legal friction. But note: Dedicated provisioning adds lead time (hardware scheduling) and a Dedicated PO may be required.

Maria G.: Action list for customer — what do we need from them to proceed?

Jamal R.: Ask them to provide: `bucket name`, `bucket ARN`, `region`, `kms key ARN`, `role ARN` (or we can send a role trust policy they paste into an IAM role), contact for their security/compliance, and confirmation they accept our short POC addendum.

Priya S.: We'll also need the exact retention window (13 months is fine), and whether they want raw or redacted exports. If raw, mark as "privacy escalation" and allow extra 3-5 business days.

Maria G.: Ok I'll request those items from Acme and loop in legal. @Jamal can you draft a short quote (numbers + timeline + required artifacts) I can send today? :thumbsup:

Jamal R.: Yup — I'll draft now and post here in thread in ~1h.

security-bot: export-pipeline check: no export currently configured for account acme-inc. If/when provided, job will run nightly.

Maria G.: Thanks everyone. Will update once they send bucket + KMS.
